name: Mockup parade
description: The same artwork shown flat, on a street hoarding, in a ring binder, on a kiosk, on a business card, on a stage slide.

recipe.build: Codex blank-mockup plates (billboard, binder, kiosk) with the film art composited by a perspective transform (matrix3d or a WebGL plane) and small live motion; 2.5-3 s each with a micro push-in.

use_when: Brand and design products; "it works everywhere".
avoid: Do not use for a product whose proof is its UI.
